mapper.select: SELECT BASE_MONTH, INCOME_AMT, INCOME_KIND_CODE FROM (SELECT BASE_MONTH, INCOME_AMT, INCOME_KIND_CODE FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY BASE_MONTH DESC FETCH FIRST 12 ROWS ONLY) ORDER BY BASE_MONTH

SELECT NVL(SUM(MONTHLY_AMT), 0) FROM USER_EXPENSE_ITEM WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EXPENSE_GROUP_CODE = 'FIXED' AND BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})
SELECT NVL(SUM(MONTHLY_AMT), 0) FROM USER_EXPENSE_ITEM WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})
SELECT NVL(SUM(MONTHLY_PAYMENT_AMT), 0) FROM USER_LOAN WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})

SELECT EXPENSE_GROUP_CODE AS expenseGroupCode, EXPENSE_CATEGORY AS expenseCategory, DESCRIPTION AS description, MONTHLY_AMT AS monthlyAmount FROM USER_EXPENSE_ITEM WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EXPENSE_GROUP_CODE != 'FIXED' AND BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY MONTHLY_AMT DESC, EXPENSE_ID

SELECT L.LOAN_ID AS loanId, T.LOAN_TYPE_NAME AS loanTypeName, L.MONTHLY_PAYMENT_AMT AS monthlyPaymentAmount FROM USER_LOAN L JOIN DIM_LOAN_TYPE T ON T.LOAN_TYPE_CODE = L.LOAN_TYPE_CODE WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId} AND L.BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY L.LOAN_ID
